Findings (1)
  CRITICAL  entry 0  MD5 signature [sig.md5]
            The certificate is signed with MD5, which is broken, and certificate signatures using it can be forged. On a self-signed CA certificate the signature is not checked when that certificate is used as a trust anchor, so there it is informational.
            Evidence: signature_algorithm=MD5-RSA
            Fix: Reissue the certificate with a SHA-256 or stronger signature.
